name: Valant EHR Suite
short_description: Behavioral health EHR and practice management platform designed by a psychiatrist for psychiatrists, therapists, and mental health practices.
long_description: Valant is a comprehensive behavioral health EHR and practice management platform founded in 2005 in Seattle, Washington by a psychiatrist. The platform is purpose-built for behavioral health providers including psychiatrists, psychologists, therapists, and practice managers. Valant offers clinical documentation with specialty-specific templates, integrated scheduling, patient engagement tools, billing and revenue cycle management, HIPAA-compliant telehealth, and built-in outcome measurement tracking (PHQ-9, GAD-7, and more). The platform includes e-prescribing with EPCS for controlled substances and PDMP integration. In March 2026, Valant launched Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) services to help practices achieve predictable revenue. The system supports various practice sizes from solo practitioners to large organizations, including specialized programs like Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOP) and Partial Hospitalization Programs (PHP).
one_liner: Behavioral health EHR designed by psychiatrists, for psychiatrists and mental health providers.
best_for: Psychiatrists and psychiatric practices needing e-prescribing with EPCS
Behavioral health practices wanting built-in outcome measurement
Group practices seeking comprehensive revenue cycle management
IOP/PHP programs needing specialized clinical workflows
not_for: General medical practices outside behavioral health
Small solo practices on tight budgets
Large enterprise organizations with complex multi-state requirements

pricing.notes: Customized pricing based on practice size, provider type, workflow needs, and add-on functionality. Tiered pricing allows practices to scale. Additional fees may apply for e-prescribing, faxes, or API usage. Contact for personalized quote.

faqs.q: How much does Valant EHR cost per month?
faqs.a: Valant EHR pricing typically ranges from $100-$300 per provider per month, with customized pricing based on practice size, provider types, and selected features. Implementation costs may apply. Contact Valant for a personalized quote.

faqs.q: Does Valant include e-prescribing for controlled substances?
faqs.a: Yes, Valant includes e-prescribing with EPCS (Electronic Prescribing for Controlled Substances) and PDMP integration, making it well-suited for psychiatrists who prescribe medications.

faqs.q: What outcome measures does Valant support?
faqs.a: Valant includes built-in outcome measurement tracking with standard assessments like PHQ-9 and GAD-7. The platform supports tracking patient progress over time and generating outcome reports.

Yes, Valant was founded by a psychiatrist and is specifically designed for behavioral health. It includes features psychiatrists need like e-prescribing with EPCS, PDMP integration, psychiatric-specific note templates, and medication management tools.
